const selected = thread.id === activeThreadId

Scope

How inherited lifecycle rules work

Computer-policy fallbacks shown here are reported by Preview computer. Each computer uses its own policies.

Automation & limits
Save to apply

Applies to existing and new threads. Inherit uses the parent scope.

Auto-resume limited threads

Continue at the provider’s reported reset time. Each thread can cancel its continuation.

Inherit (Off)

Snooze limited threads

Hide quota stops until their reported reset time. Combine with auto-resume to continue when they wake.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle merged threads

Move idle threads to Settled when their pull request merges.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle closed threads

Move idle threads to Settled when their pull request closes.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle inactive threads

Settle idle threads after the selected period. Pins, drafts and pending work are protected.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-archive settled threads

Archive threads after they remain in Settled for the selected period. Reopening resets the clock; pins, drafts and pending work are protected.

Inherit

Computer policy · Never

Continue threads after restarts

Resume interrupted turns after a runtime update, crash or computer restart.

Inherit (Off)

Days of inactivity before settling

Effective: 3 days. Applies when automatic settling is on.

Days in Settled before archiving

Effective: 7 days. Applies when auto-archive is on.

Changes apply to existing threads too.

Thread lifecycle

Recovery, settling and archiving for new and existing threads.

Editing all projects on all computers · Edits apply after saving.
Scope
Shared defaults
Project
All projects
Computer
All computers
How inherited lifecycle rules work

Computer-policy fallbacks shown here are reported by Preview computer. Each computer uses its own policies.

Automation & limits
Save to apply

Applies to existing and new threads. Inherit uses the parent scope.

Auto-resume limited threads

Continue at the provider’s reported reset time. Each thread can cancel its continuation.

Inherit (Off)

Snooze limited threads

Hide quota stops until their reported reset time. Combine with auto-resume to continue when they wake.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle merged threads

Move idle threads to Settled when their pull request merges.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle closed threads

Move idle threads to Settled when their pull request closes.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-settle inactive threads

Settle idle threads after the selected period. Pins, drafts and pending work are protected.

Inherit (Off)

Auto-archive settled threads

Archive threads after they remain in Settled for the selected period. Reopening resets the clock; pins, drafts and pending work are protected.

Inherit

Computer policy · Never

Continue threads after restarts

Resume interrupted turns after a runtime update, crash or computer restart.

Inherit (Off)

Days of inactivity before settling

Effective: 3 days. Applies when automatic settling is on.

Days in Settled before archiving

Effective: 7 days. Applies when auto-archive is on.

Changes apply to existing threads too.
